# Code of Conduct

This project is a place to share, learn and build Roblox games together. Everyone who takes part in issues, pull requests and Discussions is expected to help keep it welcoming.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to Roblox development.
- Give feedback on the work, not on the person.
- Stay on topic and keep posts useful for others who will read them later.
- Credit the work of others when you share it.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, insults, discrimination or personal attacks of any kind.
- Sharing someone else's private information.
- Spam, scams, or links to exploits, cheats or stolen assets.
- Sexual content or anything that breaks the [Roblox Community Standards](https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/203313410).

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments, issues, pull requests and discussions that break this code, and may block people who repeatedly do so.

To report a problem, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment or post, or contact the repository maintainers through GitHub. Reports are handled privately.
